AVP Marketing
  
  
**Job Description**
**Note:**
This role is hybrid with 2 days in office until September 2027, then 4 days with a new office move to Liverpool Street London.
  
  
We’re looking for an AVP of Marketing to help shape the next phase of Underwrite Me's growth.
  
  
We’re investing in our marketing capability as we expand our portfolio and bring new propositions to market. We’re looking for a leader who can strengthen how customer, commercial and market insight shape growth decisions across the business.
  
  
This is a global role, reporting to the Chief Product Officer. You’ll lead Product Marketing, Brand and Customer Marketing across our Decision Platform and Protection Platform businesses, helping us identify growth opportunities, bring new propositions to market and strengthen how we communicate value to customers.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of Product, Commercial and Marketing. You’ll play an active role in the direction of both our Decision Platform and Protection Platform businesses as part of their Leadership Teams, helping shape strategy, identify growth opportunities and influence key business decisions.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll lead a small team while remaining actively involved in strategy, positioning, launches, customer insight and key business decisions.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Define the marketing strategy across Product Marketing, Brand and Customer Marketing, owning marketing investment and budget decisions to ensure resources are focused on opportunities with the greatest commercial impact.
* Shape positioning, messaging and proposition strategy across the UnderwriteMe portfolio, helping customers understand our value and commercial teams communicate it effectively.
* Lead go-to-market strategy for new products, capabilities and strategic initiatives, improving the effectiveness of launches and market adoption.
* Bring customer, market and competitive insight into product, commercial and business decision-making, ensuring priorities are informed by evidence rather than assumption.

* Establish clear measures of success for marketing activities and use insight and performance data to continuously improve effectiveness and impact.
* Represent the voice of the customer and market in senior leadership discussions, influencing business strategy and helping the organisation make better decisions.
* Lead, develop and grow a high-performing marketing team, creating clarity, accountability and strong cross-functional collaboration.

What success looks like

* Build a connected marketing community across UnderwriteMe, bringing together Product, Brand and Customer Marketing with the local Revenue Marketing teams to share insight, align priorities and maximise impact.

jobs.description:
#### **Our Mission**

##### **Money sitting idle is money lost. We're fixing that.**

Founded in 2023 by Antoine and Paul-Adrien, Spiko gives businesses, non-profits, financial advisers, and fintechs access to institutional-grade cash management, via app or API. We are building the full infrastructure: issuing, operating, and distributing the products ourselves.

Two years after launch, we serve thousands of organizations across Europe and process hundreds of millions of euros in flows every month.

Our ambition: become the world's leading treasury management infrastructure in a market worth trillions.

We are backed by Index Ventures, the CEO of Revolut, the founder of Kyriba, and the CTO of Wise.

Spiko runs on excellence, transparency, and straight talk.

#### **The Role: Content and Events Management (UK)**

Spiko is building its UK business, and content and events are how UK founders, CFOs, treasurers, wealth managers, funds and property groups will first meet Spiko. This role shapes that first impression.

As Content and Events Manager (UK), you are the content and events engine for Spiko in the UK. You film, edit and write the content that explains and promotes Spiko, and you run the events that bring prospects into the room. You make sure the right content gets made, reaches the right people, and turns into conversations and pipeline.

You'll report to the GM, and work with the sector heads and the sales team, and with the central team that runs Spiko's paid, marketing and brand functions, so that UK activity fits the wider brand and plan.

This is a hands-on role with room to grow. We want someone who enjoys making things, is willing to write, and wants to develop into a full marketer. Your scope grows as Spiko grows and does more.

Success means a steady rhythm of high-quality UK content that sales and sector heads use every week, a calendar of UK events that prospects remember, delivered on budget and with strong supplier terms, measurable meetings and pipeline from both, smooth working with the central paid, marketing and brand team, and growth in your own skills and scope as a marketer

#### **Key Responsibilities**

**Create Content**

* You will film, edit and produce video, social content, event recaps and customer stories for the UK business, using our AI tools to move fast and keep quality high.
* You will write clear, accurate content: posts, articles, emails, one-pagers and event material.
* You will work with the sector heads and sales team to find the stories and topics that matter to founders, CFOs, treasurers, wealth managers, funds and property groups.
* You will build a content calendar and keep a steady rhythm of output.  
    
  **Get Content to the Right People**
* You will work closely with the teams to make sure the right content is produced and gets to the right people, through LinkedIn, email, sales outreach, events and partner channels.
* You will give sales a library of content they can use in conversations.
* You will track what works, and shift effort towards the content that drives meetings and pipeline.  
    
  **Run Events**
* You will plan and run UK events, dinners, roundtables and conference presence that amaze our prospects.
* You will source venues, speakers and suppliers, and negotiate hard to get the best terms for Spiko.
* You will manage event budgets, logistics and follow-up, and work with sales to turn every event into pipeline.  
    
  **Manage Agencies and Freelancers**
* You will manage agencies and freelancers across content and events wherever we need them, from video production to venues and event delivery.
* You will brief them clearly, negotiate scope and price, hold them to deadlines and quality, and keep spend within budget.
* You will decide what to produce in house with our AI tools and what to hand to specialists.  
    
  **Work with the Central Team**
* You will work with the central team running Spiko's paid, marketing and brand functions, and follow brand guidelines and review processes.
* You will coordinate UK paid campaigns and brand activity with the central plan.
* You will make sure content in this regulated sector meets our compliance review before it goes out.

#### **Who we’re looking for**

##### **Requirements (must-haves):**

* 3 to 5 years in content, events, marketing or a related role.
* Hands-on skill in filming and editing video, with a portfolio you can show us.
* Comfortable writing content, and willingness to do more of it as the role grows.
* Experience running events end to end, with the confidence to negotiate hard with suppliers and secure the best deal.
* Fluency with AI tools for content creation, research and admin, and curiosity about new ones.
* Strong organisation and project management across several workstreams at once.

##### **Nice to have:**

* Interest in fintech, finance or the sectors we serve.
* Experience managing agencies or freelancers.

#### **What we Offer**

* **Compensation**: Competitive package depending on experience + Stock Options
* **Offices**: in central Paris & London
* **Remote work**: up to 2 days per week and one full remote week per month
* **The best tech for your job**: latest-generation laptops and industry-leading software
* **Health insurance**: 100% covered by Spiko
* **Monthly Budget** to cover different perks of choice
* **Referral Bonus**
* **Social life**: regular afterworks and biannual offsites

#### **Our Hiring Process**

* Screening Interview - 30 mins with Matthew Swann, Talent Acquisition Manager
* Hiring Manager interview - 30 mins with hiring manager Ciaran O'Malley GM UK&I
* Business Case: To work on at home and present online or in person
* Final in-person Interviews with the Founders
* Reference Check: we'll reach out to your references to gather further insights
* Offer

*If something here doesn't match your résumé perfectly but you believe you'd thrive in this role, apply anyway. Tell us why.*

Don't wait for the future of infrastructure. Be part of it.

Teleport is the AI Infrastructure Identity Company. We're solving one of the hardest problems in security: giving every human, machine, workload, and AI agent a cryptographically secured identity, improving engineering velocity while maintaining security. We make trusted computing simple. This gives you the freedom, power, and autonomy to build and innovate with confidence.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we work with companies like Nasdaq, DoorDash, and Elastic to secure infrastructure for an AI world.

We are looking for a Field Marketing Manager to lead and execute regional and partner-led event programs that drive pipeline and revenue across the U.S. This role reports to the Senior Channel Marketing Manager and works cross-functionally with Sales, Channel Marketing, Global Campaigns, and Partner Marketing to align regional strategies with go-to-market goals.

The ideal candidate thrives in a dynamic environment and brings a strong understanding of field marketing execution, partner and channel collaboration, and event-driven demand generation. If you’re self-motivated, coachable, and ready to drive meaningful impact in a cutting-edge cybersecurity company, we’d love to meet you.

* Own and execute regional and partner-led field marketing programs that drive pipeline and revenue, including executive roundtables, webinars, co-branded events, and strategic partner activations.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Channel, and Partner Marketing to align programs with GTM goals and ensure measurable impact on pipeline generation and acceleration.
* Support the execution and logistics of Teleport-hosted and third-party events (virtual, in-person, hybrid), ensuring seamless execution and integration into broader campaign strategy.
* Lead and scale field initiatives in collaboration with key technology and channel partners—delivering joint experiences that engage target accounts and create shared value.
* Serve as a strategic marketing partner to sales leadership, supporting territory planning and creating tailored programs that support early-stage pipeline and late-stage deal acceleration.
* Leverage campaign, content, and product marketing teams to ensure programs resonate with target personas across the buyer journey—from developer to decision-maker.
* Analyze, report, and optimize field programs based on ROI, lead quality, pipeline influence, and conversion metrics; share learnings and recommendations to scale what works.
* Create repeatable toolkits and “events-in-a-box” playbooks that empower sales and partners to activate field marketing motions globally.

### **Qualifications**

* 4–6 years of experience in field marketing, demand generation, or integrated campaigns at B2B SaaS companies, preferably supporting both PLG and enterprise sales motions.
* Demonstrated success in building and scaling field marketing programs that deliver measurable pipeline impact.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to balance strategic thinking with tactical execution.
* Experience with partner marketing and executing joint programs with technology or cloud partners.
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce, marketing automation platforms (e.g., Hubspot or Marketo), and ABM tools (e.g., 6sense or Demandbase).
* Comfortable collaborating closely with Sales and CS teams; you know how to translate GTM priorities into marketing programs that work.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to adapt messaging to technical and business audiences.
* Data-driven mindset with a bias toward experimentation, performance tracking, and continuous improvement.
* Willingness to travel (up to 40%) for event execution and on-site collaboration.

Bonus Points: Familiarity with infrastructure, security, or developer tools—and a passion for bringing technical communities together through experiences.

You're joining a company where the problem is real, the team is small, and your work shows up directly in the product. We're not a big company, you won't get lost in a crowd. You'll have the freedom and autonomy to do what you're great at, alongside teammates who care about doing it right and want to see you succeed. The work is collaborative, there's real room to grow, and the mission is one worth showing up for.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we're genuinely passionate about what we're building.

**Your mission at Mercanis**

We are looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to help scale Mercanis's presence globally. This is a performance- and pipeline-driven role: you will own a number, not just a set of activities. You'll sit at the intersection of outbound and inbound, making sure both teams are aligned on target accounts and pipeline goals — and you will own the channels and campaigns that drive it. The initial focus is on the UK & DACH, and then globally, so you will have room to test what works beyond the core. Reporting to VP of Marketing, working in collaboration with Product Marketing, Field Marketing, Design, and Content.

**Your Responsibilities on this role**

* Drive market expansion in the UK & Ireland region — build the regional campaigns and channel mix to grow pipeline in the market we're actively scaling
* Grow Mercanis's market presence in the DACH market — build awareness and demand generation among procurement and operations decision-makers
* Own a monthly pipeline number across your markets, and be directly accountable for hitting it
* Be the connector between the outbound and inbound teams, aligning with the sales team on target accounts and lead handoff
* Own and optimize paid acquisition across LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, and other channels— managing budget, targeting, and creative testing against hard pipeline and CAC targets
* Brief and ship SEO-driven landing pages and content to improve organic visibility and inbound lead quality, in a collaboration with the content writer
* Plan and run campaigns targeting sign-ups for events, webinars, in a collaboration with the field marketer
* Build and own full-funnel reporting and attribution in HubSpot (MQLs, pipeline, ROI), so we always know exactly what's driving pipeline — and iterate fast based on what the data shows & sales team’s feedback
* Partner with Sales to sharpen lead-qualification criteria for each market
* Run a continuous test-and-learn cadence — prioritize experiments by expected impact on pipeline and CAC, and kill fast what doesn't perform
* Run experiments into new markets beyond the UK & DACH — small-scale tests on channels, messaging, and demand to see where it's worth doubling down next

**Role requirements**

* 5+ years of growth or performance marketing experience in B2B SaaS or tech, ideally at a fast-growing company, with a track record of hitting pipeline and revenue targets
* Knowledge of HubSpot for campaign execution, lead scoring, and reporting
* Knowledge of LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, and Meta — hands-on experience planning, running, and optimizing paid campaigns against CAC and pipeline targets
* Experience writing SEO briefs and working with content/design to produce landing pages that convert
* Comfort working cross-functionally with outbound (SDR) and inbound teams to align on ICP and lead handoff & lead feedback
* A performance-marketing mindset — you think in CAC, pipeline velocity, and ROI, and you're comfortable owning a number
* A data-driven mindset — comfortable reading funnel metrics (MQL/SQL/pipeline/CAC) and turning insights into action fast
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving fast in a scale-up environment
* Nice to have: experience growing a market in the UK and DACH region, background in procurement, supply chain, or other enterprise B2B software

**Why to join us here at Mercanis?**

* A high-ownership role at a fast-growing, AI-native procurement scale-up
* A hybrid of onsite collaboration in London or Berlin with a close-knit, international team
* Competitive salary and equity package
* Budget for learning, tools, and professional development
* The chance to shape growth marketing strategy as we expand globally, starting with the UK & DACH

#### **About Smartnumbers**

We are on a mission to stop fraud and improve customer authentication. Fraud is a huge problem affecting millions of people, it costs the UK nearly £7bn and represents 40% of all crime. Too often the solution has been to put in place cumbersome authentication processes that frustrate genuine customers, cause inefficiencies for organisations and fail to prevent fraud.  
  
We are changing this by providing organisations with real-time insight into the risk of a caller. We combine patented machine learning technology with our deep domain knowledge to prevent contact centre fraud.  
  
We recognise that we need to work together to fight fraud, that is why we have fostered strategic partnerships with leading global organisations like Amazon, BT, Genesys and NICE. Together, we protect the UK's largest retail banks, investment banks and emergency services. We also believe in developing our people and developing high performing teams.

#### **What you'll be working on**

We are rapidly expanding our product offerings and becoming a multi-product organisation, serving new markets and geographies, increasing the need for cohesive, valuable and structured messaging for a wider and more diverse set of buyers and use cases.  
  
You will own the product story for each of our propositions, keep it true to the product, and make sure our sellers and partners can tell it well. The types of areas you'll look at include:

  

* Positioning and messaging - building the story for each product and each buyer with Sales and Marketing, and testing it with sellers before it is final
* Competitive insight - understanding what our competitors build and why, and turning that into battlecards, objection handling and win/loss reviews that sharpen how we sell
* Launches - planning and preparing launches with the product managers, including the launch kit and internal readiness
* Sales and partner enablement - pitch decks, demo stories, playbooks and training for our sellers, and train-the-trainer material for partners such as BT
* Proof - case studies, ROI stories and references built to the standard large enterprises expect, with claims that stand up to scrutiny
* Market insight and thought leadership - buyer research, bringing what you learn back into product decisions, and writing about new use cases, market trends, what our data shows and what new regulation means for our customers.

**How you'll work**  
  
This is a hands-on role. You'll write the messaging, build the battlecards and prepare the launches yourself, as there is no team or agency to hand work to. You'll report to the Chief Product & Strategy Officer and work most closely with our product managers across our product portfolio, as well as Sales and Marketing.  
  
We're a product-led organisation. We build our understanding of the market from evidence gathered across many sources: sales conversations, customers, events, research and our own data. Go-to-market is shared between Product and Sales, and you'll be the link between the two. That means explaining where the product is going and why, taking feedback from the field seriously, and changing the story when the evidence says it should change.  
  
We're a start-up that sells to some of the UK's largest enterprise businesses, so our material needs to stand alongside much bigger suppliers. You'll also have room to choose your own topics, such as new use cases, new markets and changes in regulation, while staying closely aligned with our wider product strategy and roadmap.  
  
We're a close-knit company so there'll be plenty of exposure to the rest of the business, including executives.

#### **What you'll need for the role**

Smartnumbers values diversity of experience. Candidates should have a strong combination of several of the following skills, competencies and experience:

  

* Competitive insight - You've built and run a competitive programme in B2B security, fraud, identity or communications. You can explain a competitor's strategy, not just its feature list, and you've used that insight to change a product decision or a sales approach
* Technical understanding - You've marketed technical products to technical buyers and can explain how a product works, and where its limits are, in plain English. Telephony or contact centre experience helps but isn't required
* Writing for more than one buyer - You've positioned one platform to different buyers, changing the message while keeping the product facts the same
* Claims that stand up - You've turned customer and product data into proof points, worked with legal or compliance reviewers, and know what not to say
* Shared ownership - You've worked as a peer to sales leaders, debating and agreeing positions without formal authority. You seek feedback early and change your view when the evidence supports it
* Launch and partner experience - You've led B2B launches from start to finish, kept them on track when dates moved, and built enablement for resellers, telcos or contact centre platform partners
* Building from a blank page - You've been the first or only product marketer somewhere, or set up the function from scratch, and produced work to an enterprise standard without a large team behind you

  
How you work with others matters just as much. We look for people who are curious, open to challenge, collaborative and low-ego, and honest about what they don't know.  
  
It would be a bonus if you use AI tools in your day-to-day work, or have experience with industry analysts or HubSpot.

#### **What we can offer you**

As well as a competitive salary of £80,000 to £90,000 per annum, depending on experience, we also offer a comprehensive benefits package, covering a variety of areas, both professional and personal. These benefits include:

  

* Hybrid working style, with the expectation of two days in the office (with a great City of London office base!)
* Family friendly benefits including paid parental leave policies
